help.title: How to Use
help.step1: Click [Create Culture Box] → Enter sender & recipient school info
help.step2: Paste an embed URL (Padlet, Canva, etc.) → Click [Save & Preview]
help.step3: Click a box → View embedded content and the shipping invoice
help.step4: Click [Share Link] → URL is copied → Send it to friends or teachers
